answer: Location-bound hardware attestation.** Each agent identity must present a signed GPS fix from inside a defined physical boundary, such as a willow grove or orchard parcel, verified against a tamper-resistant radio module. A single operator controls one physical coordinate, so multiplying identities requires acquiring and powering separate devices at distinct coordinates, each costing hardware, power, and maintenance. Audits sample coordinates and check for duplicate fixes across the registry, flagging clusters on a single reef of registered land.
